bar_applied.lead_rule: the 95 percent paired cluster-bootstrap interval of model minus logistic real-family top-1 at the top rung, over the scored real chunks with the slope bootstrap's own resamples: entirely above 0 is MODEL_LEADS, entirely below 0 is LINEAR_LEADS, otherwise NO_SEPARATION (never 'equal'); the verdict string carries it as a suffix. If the model or the logistic at the top rung is at its iteration cap, the suffix is still read by the rule, but every document that states it states '(the <role> at its iteration cap at the top rung)' in the same sentence and the lead is not quoted as a recipe comparison, exactly as the difference flag is not

flags.difference_reading: the paired interval includes 0: not resolved at this size; never read as 'equal'
flags.second_decade_reading: at or above the record's rate
flags.share_is: a description of the resamples, not a probability that the model is better

shift_arm.note: informational: rung 5's new plaintexts alone at rung 4's plaintext count; the difference from rung 4 reads what other files of the same families buy for the original files at the same count; never a verdict

top_rung_against_0021s_bar_with_the_high.is: informational: the same clause with OPERATING_RULES 4a's list taken literally - logistic regression is among the trivial baselines it names, 0021's four did not include it, and the standardised logistic is fitted at every rung here

top_rung_against_0021s_bar_with_the_tree.is: informational: 0021's clause (best trivial baseline on the same rows plus 0.05) re-applied at the top rung with the depth-3 tree standing in for the best of 0021's four baselines; the other three read below the tree at 0021 and are not refitted here, so a floor above the tree's is possible and this flag can only be optimistic

The shift arm (rung 5's new plaintexts alone, rung 4's count) reads {'depth3_tree': 0.0923, 'logistic': 0.118, 'model': 0.1184}, against rung 4 by {'depth3_tree': -0.0006, 'logistic': 0.0001, 'model': -0.0009}. at the top rung the model leads the standardised logistic by 0.0039 (paired interval [0.0001, 0.0077], entirely above 0). Against 0021's bar with the tree as the floor, the top rung reads 0.1404 against 0.1419 needed (does not clear; informational, the floor is the tree alone). Not a transfer reading: every rung holds the scored files' own unscored chunks; the added plaintexts are other files of the same families; nothing fitted shares a byte, a chunk id or a source-chunk hash with anything scored; the intervals are over the scored chunks only and do not resample the fit side. Nothing here revises 0003, 0014, 0015, 0016, 0017, 0018, 0019, 0021, 0022 or 0023, and nothing here establishes a buyer. A rise the logistic and the tree share is a rise of the cheap signal, not of the recipe. Nothing beyond the top rung is banked.
